blockedBy: Disabled together with 04-feedback-relay: tests/CardsFeedbackTests.cs asserts the exact upstream issue-template URL. Keeping the browser fallback unchanged avoids changing feedback behaviour.
rationale: With the relay disabled, browser fallback builds a prefilled issue URL from IssueBase. Point it at the publisher's repository, which carries the same .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/device-request.yml inherited from the fork.
compliance: Only changes where a user's own report is submitted; CREDITS.md retains the original project URL.
